messages:
Samir K: quick heads-up, my flight got delayed. I need to hand primary off ~20m earlier than planned. Can @Jia L pick up primary at 14:30 UTC? I'll shadow for an hour. :airplane:
Oncall Bot: [auto] rotation request received for schedule 'eng-inference' — current primary Samir K, requested handoff to Jia L at 14:30 UTC.
Jia L: I can take primary at 14:30 UTC. will run preflight and keep an eye on canaries.
Samir K: thanks. current noisy alert: inference-503 spike in eu-west1. I applied a retry-loop mitigation but error rate is ~10% still.
Elena P: FYI the creds rotation is scheduled at 15:00 UTC (nonblocking) — try not to restart pods around then.
Samir K: good call. Jia, here's the runbook snippet: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff#prim-swap — follow the preflight checklist and confirm pd status.
Jia L: copying runbook. quick checklist I'm running now:
```
- confirm primary/secondary in PagerDuty
- `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide`
- smoke test: `curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference/internal/health`
- validate canary keys and routes
```
Jia L: i'll also enable traffic-drain reversal policy if p95 > 500ms.
Ops Pager: [PagerDuty] Notification: You are now scheduled as primary for 'eng-inference' — Jia L (pending confirmation).
Jia L: confirming — taking primary at 14:30 UTC. current metrics: 120 rps, p50 95ms, p95 420ms, error rate 6% after Samir's retry fix.
Elena P: customer-impact: 3 customers reported degraded completions last hour (CS# 4521, 4523, 4527). if errors spike, prioritize routing to fallback-model-quantized.
Jia L: plan: 1) watch error rate, if >8% switch route to fallback-model-quantized. 2) if not stabilizing in 10m escalate to infra @Samir.
Samir K: I'll remain reachable via DM and keep shadowing logs for 1 hr. leaving a quick note in the runbook under 'failback' commands.
Jia L: doing a smoke now:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .status
```
Jia L: smoke response OK. starting transition prep, will rotate primary in 3m.
Oncall Bot: rotation completed — primary: Jia L, secondary: Elena P.
Samir K: handing off now. leaving context: eu-west1 errors traced to a bad retry/backoff loop in the A/B router; patched and observing. :white_check_mark:
Jia L: updated #incidents pinned runbook with short note + links to CS tickets. I'll keep 15m intensive watch then move to standard cadence.
Elena P: I remain secondary. I'll monitor the credential rotation at 15:00 UTC and validate no pod restarts during it.
Ops Pager: Note: if customer impact escalates, trigger page-1 to infra_oncall and follow escalation ladder in runbook.
Jia L: ack — thanks all. Samir, safe travels.
Samir K: thanks — appreciate the cover. :thumbsup:
